name: Vahini-20-Factor-Handwriting-Analyser-SBOM
comment: Source dependency inventory: exact npm lockfile packages (including transitive dev tooling), pinned CDN PDF.js and libheif-js, and declared Python core/default-engine dependencies. Unresolved Python ranges are recorded in comments, not as installed versions. Datasets used for training, tests and evaluation are SPDXRef-Data-* packages (purpose OTHER), described in docs/22-datasets.md; print_hand.json is the one first-party weights file. This is not a complete container SBOM: Python transitive packages, OS libraries, third-party model weights and optional OCR tiers require an inventory from the built image. Rolling font and hosted-service entries describe runtime integrations.

packages.name: tests/fixtures/samples
packages.comment: Dataset (SPDX 2.3 has no data purpose). Old letters (1722, 1889), a 1929 receipt, font specimens and printed forms used by the handwriting-only tests and as real test lines for print_hand.json. Source and licence not recorded. Not in the image.

packages.name: GNHK: GoodNotes Handwriting Kollection
packages.versionInfo: Hugging Face mirror aryaman27/goodnotes-handwritten-dataset at 904297760a9fec813fdc1ecb5f8055cb1ca03550, fetched 2026-10-19
packages.comment: Dataset (SPDX 2.3 has no data purpose). Lee, Chung and Lee, ICDAR 2021. Licence stated in the official repository; the mirror the files came from declares none and was not compared with the official release. Evaluation only: 200 photos scored on 2026-10-19 (docs/history/real-photos-gnhk-2026-10-19.md). Holds personal data; not in this repository or the image.

packages.name: handwriting-sample.jpg
packages.comment: Dataset (SPDX 2.3 has no data purpose). One adult's notebook page. Author, source and terms not recorded. Ships in the image as frontend/assets/samples/handwriting-sample.jpg and as crops in frontend/scripts/core/sample-report-data.js; also tests/fixtures/ and benchmarks/sample-page/.

packages.name: IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS-Telugu
packages.versionInfo: 80,637 training words; source page not recorded
packages.comment: Dataset (SPDX 2.3 has no data purpose). Gongidi and Jawahar, ICDAR 2021. ILOCR and the AIKOSH portal state CC BY 4.0; the ICFHR 2022 IHTR split (80,637 Telugu training words, the same count as our copy) is for that competition only; terms for our copy unverified. Trains the Telugu reader (weights not committed, not used by a scan) and builds Telugu evaluation pages kept outside the repository. Not in this repository or the image.

packages.name: Palmer Method (1915) and Zaner-Bloser Manual 144
packages.comment: Dataset (SPDX 2.3 has no data purpose). Also https://archive.org/details/zaner-method-writing-manual-144. Public domain as recorded in benchmarks/neat-penmanship/source.md. Eight crops committed in benchmarks/neat-penmanship/pages; not in the image.

packages.name: google/fonts (24 families for printed training lines)
packages.comment: Dataset (SPDX 2.3 has no data purpose). Font files listed with their SHA-256 in scripts/print_hand_data.py, used to render the printed lines that train and test print_hand.json. Special Elite is Apache-2.0, the rest OFL-1.1. No font file is included.

packages.name: UJI Pen Characters (Version 2)
packages.supplier: Organization: Universitat Jaume I and Universitat Politecnica de Valencia (UCI Machine Learning Repository)
packages.comment: Dataset (SPDX 2.3 has no data purpose). Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar, 2008, doi:10.24432/C5FG8S; licence stated on https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/177/uji+pen+characters+version+2. 40 training writers train print_hand.json; the 20 test writers make the synthetic test pages and the 20 rendered pages in benchmarks/uji-clean/pages (committed, not in the image). The raw file is not redistributed. See docs/22-datasets.md.
